notes_long:
- Use case: legal/compliance search + reranking for internal investigations. Currently using keyword search + rules; want ML ranking to reduce manual review time.
- Latency/throughput targets: p50 <120ms for rerank API, peak 200 qps expected for nightly batch and 5 qps interactive. Cost sensitive: senior leadership expects < $0.10/1000 tokens equivalent for steady-state.
- Model preference: open to quantized Llama-family or equivalent; strict on key management and ability to run in VPC/private control plane.
- Security: heavy push from infosec - require SOC2, SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration, data residency in US. SE provided draft architecture and data flow on 2025-11-20.
- What happened: After SE submitted detailed answers and a POC sizing estimate (Dec-Jan), primary champion (Head of ML Ops, Tom Bradford) took extended leave and contact went quiet. We received one note from procurement saying 'pausing external pilots until next budget cycle' and then no replies.
- Competitive notes: Procurement mentioned evaluating managed vendor bundled with existing cloud provider (cheaper short-term, less tooling). Notable: 'we like the idea but the friction to onboard a new vendor is high right now' (quote from procurement).
- AE/SE read: account still strategic — aligns well with Redwood product fit (private deployment + optimize). Key risk: no clear internal sponsor and finance freeze.
- Suggested re-engagement: shorter ask (10-15 min) to confirm status, offer time-limited pilot credits and a pre-configured VPC trial, loop solutions exec if procurement non-responsive.
- Artifacts: security FAQ, POC plan, cost worksheet in Drive.
